title: Reconcile webhooks against the Logs API
summary: Page through voice and message logs, find entries missing from your webhook store, and retrieve each missing call's event history.
scenario: A nightly job that finds the calls and messages your status handler has no record of

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json GET /api/voice/logs and /api/messaging/logs: created_after, created_before, page_size 1-1000; GET /api/voice/logs/{id}/events -> Voice.LogEvent{event_at, level, name, details, project_id, log_id}
